review:
Snow Slingers is a festive version of the 2 Wild 2 Die design: penguins throw snowballs instead of bullets. Snow-volver symbols land with one to six snowballs and throw them at random positions. A first hit sticks as a wild Snow symbol, and later hits add a random multiplier.

Epic Snow-volvers skip straight to multiplier wilds. Two bonus games build on the snowball fight, and the 10,000x cap is available in every mode. If you already know 2 Wild 2 Die, you'll learn this one in a single spin, and it's lighter in tone.
